about: Inkling 2 Mini (26B looped MoE, ~3B active, vision, thinking) UD-Q4_K_XL with the F16 vision projector and the DSpark Q8_0 draft model (--spec-type draft-dspark, 3 drafted tokens) on one 24 GB card, everything on the GPU. llama.cpp from Unsloth's prebuilt b12649-mix-c7059d6 (CUDA 12 'newer' build; the 2026-11-23 Unsloth update that speeds up the looped layers ~1.4x on this card), with the GGUFs as re-published on 2026-11-23. CUDA graphs stay ON: with this build the full 131,072-token window fits at -ub 512 with q8_0 KV and survives back-to-back ~117k-token prompts (the b12572 launch needed -ub 128 and GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1). Do not use the cuda13 archives on a CUDA 12 driver: they fall back to the CPU silently. Thinking Machines' recommended sampling, one slot. Measured on one RTX 3090 24GB: ~23.1 GB VRAM.
setup: Not Docker; Linux x86-64 with an NVIDIA driver for CUDA 12.x. Unpack the archive into llama-b12649-mix-c7059d6/ next to models/ and run from that directory. Keep the card otherwise empty: at 131,072 tokens the launch takes ~23.1 of 24.5 GB.
